_comment: Metadata for the docs/ manual. The last_synced_commit is the commit at which docs/ was last verified against the implementation; the sync-docs skill (.agents/skills/sync-docs/SKILL.md) diffs HEAD against it and updates this file. Committed to git on purpose so the baseline persists across sessions and machines. A dotfile + .json so a future docs website does not render it as a page.
